title: eval-harness: CI prompt-regression enhancements and per-prompt metrics integration
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: The eval-harness CI previously ran a single coarse-grained prompt regression gate which reported aggregate failures but lacked per-prompt metrics and signal to quickly identify quality regressions. This PR introduces per-prompt regression checks, integrates additional eval metrics (EM, BLEU-like scoring for structured outputs, token-level divergence), and refactors the CI hooks to expose per-prompt pass/fail and severity levels. Motivation: enable faster triage for model upgrades and avoid noisy all-or-nothing gating that blocks unrelated changes. What this changes: 1) New CI hook eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_gate.py that computes per-prompt metrics, applies threshold tiers (critical/warning/info), and emits structured annotations in CI; 2) Integration layer eval-harness/metrics/per_prompt_metrics.py with EM and token-divergence implementations and adapters for existing eval backends; 3) CI config update .github/workflows/eval-ci.yaml to add per-prompt artifact upload and rerun-on-flaky-policy; 4) Tests under eval-harness/tests/ covering metric calculation and gate logic; 5) Docs updated with gating semantics and how to add new prompts. Checklist: - [x] Per-prompt metric computation implemented - [x] Backwards-compatible default thresholds - [x] Tests added for key edge cases - [x] CI workflow wired and smoke-tested - [x] Release notes drafted Rollout plan: feature is behind a config flag per-repo and will be enabled for small set of repos for 1 week, then ramped. If a regression is detected we will fallback to aggregate gate; a monitoring dashboard will track per-prompt noise. Notes: thresholds are conservative to limit false positives; future PR will add adaptive thresholds based on historical noise. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4521, ENG-4590, SUP-8791. Links: docs/eval-harness/quality-gating.md, internal/infra/ci-notes#eval-gates
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add per-prompt metrics module and basic EM/token-divergence implementations; 2) Add CI hook and workflow changes to run per-prompt gates and upload artifacts; 3) Tests and docs. (Author: Ava Chen)

release_notes: Introduce per-prompt regression gating in the eval-harness CI. Adds EM and token-divergence metrics, per-prompt pass/fail reporting, and conservative default thresholds. Gate is configurable and rolled out behind a flag. See docs/eval-harness/quality-gating.md for details.
notes: This PR reduces time-to-detect prompt-level regressions and improves triage for model rollouts. Flagged for incremental rollout to avoid noise spikes.
